description: This file defines data structures and functions for managing question groups in a developer roadmap project, including fetching all question groups, fetching by ID, and fetching multiple by IDs. It handles parsing markdown files, extracting frontmatter, and related content.

classes.name: RawQuestionGroupFrontmatter
classes.description: Interface defining the frontmatter structure for question group markdown files.

classes.name: QuestionType
classes.description: Type representing individual questions with their answer, ID, and topics.

classes.name: QuestionGroupType
classes.description: Type representing a question group with questions, topics, author info, related guides, and optional ending content.

methods.name: getAllQuestionGroups
methods.description: Fetches all question group markdown files, processes them, and returns an array of question groups with associated data.

methods.name: getQuestionGroupById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific question group by its ID.

methods.name: getQuestionGroupsByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple question groups based on an array of IDs, returning their basic info.
